Name: (CP) Burnt Sienna Wood and Gold Shipping Bin and Mailbox
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4]Updated for 1.6!  Now includes: Ginger Island Bin, Gold Mailboxes in Cabins and Ginger Island; and Optional Mini Shipping Bins![/size]

[size=4]Original Content Patcher versions thanks to [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/16947684]finduilan[/url][size=4]! [/size]

Recolors the shipping bin and mailbox to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1877]Burnt Sienna Wood and Gold Craftables[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1899]Mushroom Boxes. [/url]

[b]To install Content Patcher version--
[/b][b]1.[/b] Install [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[b]2. [/b]Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
[/font][font=Tahoma]3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using Notepad++ or program of your choice) to toggle Mini Shipping Bin on or off (default is Mini Shipping Bin: true). Alternatively, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make your choice in-game.﻿
[/font][font=Tahoma]4. Load up your game and enjoy![/font]
